posts.name: Kyle Kondik
posts.text: Suffolk has the Ohio races 48-44 Acton and 47-44 Brown this morning. They have both Dems very nominally up in NE Ohio’s Portage (Kent State U) - Obama-to-Trump territory. I don’t know if Portage is “must-win” for Ds now but they would need to be fairly close in all likelihood
posts.note: Fresh Ohio poll with Democrats narrowly ahead in Senate and governor races.

posts.name: Nate Silver
posts.text: There's something even weirder. For the Gov race, Marist lists 2% undecideds among registered voters. But that jumps to 6% among likely voters! That literally doesn't make sense. You shouldn't have a 3x increase in undecideds in a LV sample; typically, the percentage gets lower. https://t.co/LZgJjROyBz
posts.note: Why to read crosstabs skeptically: undecideds that rise among likely voters are a red flag.

posts.name: Erick Erickson
posts.text: On the Anthropic "breach" of Georgia voter data, they did not access voter files.  Claude accessed the public data on who has voted, outstanding absentee ballots, etc.  I know because Claude built a tracker of the data.  There was nothing illegal.  It's a great use of AI. And https://t.co/mHqLmtZIUb
posts.note: Pushback on the Georgia voter-data story: public turnout data, not voter files.
